title: Store vocabulary
description: The closed sets of words the store pipeline spells. GENERATED from contracts/store/vocabulary.js by contracts/store/generate.mjs — do not hand-edit vocabulary.json. This schema grades the SHAPE; tooling/ci/assert-store-vocabulary.mjs grades the CONTENT against the consumers, in both directions.

listingFields.description: The ONE listing-field table. Four hand-typed arrays used to be filtered out of nothing; they are now filtered out of this.

app.description: 'required' on every application listing tree; 'additional' on some channels only (which channels is a per-row fact in tooling/channel-register.json); 'form-rule' = required on the trees of a channel whose storeFormRules row names it as answersFile (never in additionalFiles: a .json there is a sworn declaration); null = not an application listing field.

extension.description: 'per-store' = one copy in EVERY store directory; 'per-store-additional' = lives in a store directory but only some stores take it, and WHICH stores is a per-row fact — in extensions/scripts/store-graphics.json for an image, and the store directory that holds the file for a text field (Edge's search-terms.txt, AMO's tags.txt); 'shared' = one copy in store/_shared/, required of every tool; 'shared-additional' = one copy in store/_shared/ but only some tools have it; null = not an extension listing field.

rendered.description: Whether tooling/app-yaml/render.mjs writes this file from app.yaml.

listingCategories.description: Per channel id, the category strings this portfolio declares. NOT the store's own closed set — no store category list has been fetched from a primary source, and an invented one would fire on correct input.

storeFormRules.description: Per channel id, the STORE's own upload-form validators, read from the form itself and cited. Unlike listingCategories, these are the store's closed sets.

appleCategoryUti.description: Per portfolio category word, the Apple category UTI tooling/app-yaml/render.mjs writes into LSApplicationCategoryType in both Apple Info.plists. Covers every category listingCategories lists on an Apple channel.

wordSet.description: A closed set of words. minItems 1 because an empty axis satisfies every 'is this value declared?' check vacuously.
